audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' while win[4..6] and packet.levelChart all read 'Akshan'. Three rows rendered two answers. The tldr also claimed he 'has to enter soldier range to kill you', which is false for an 850-range boomerang and a 2500-range ultimate.
audit.why: Avengerang is 850 to your 525 soldier range, and Comeuppance is 2500. He never has to close.
audit.corrected: Full-layer sides moved to Akshan on rows 4-6 with each why rewritten to argue that verdict; tldr replaced with the range reality.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and First-item rows described Azir spikes on rows the chart gives to Akshan.
audit.why: Comeuppance is 100/85/70 and scales on missing health at 2500 range; Heroic Swing drops from 18s to 12s by rank 5, so his escape gets faster exactly as your Nashor's lands.
audit.corrected: Level 6 row keyed to Comeuppance's minion-blocking, First item row to the 12s Heroic Swing, 2+ items to his 70s global.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never stated the two interactions that decide this lane: Heroic Swing requires terrain to anchor and he is knocked off it on collision with champions or terrain; Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion, or structure it hits.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'fires a grappling hook into terrain... He can jump off early or gets knocked off when colliding with champions or terrain.' Riot's R text: 'dealing damage based on missing health to the first champion, minion, or structure hit.'
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, report[5].t, phases[2].why and phases[4].why — including that a minion body eats his ultimate.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it, and the packet flagged zero cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere in the matchup.
audit.why: Lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT plus packet defect 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing 18s at rank 1 / 12s at rank 5, Avengerang 9s at rank 1, Comeuppance 100s, your E 19s at rank 3, with an explicit fight-in-that-gap instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: Avengerang was treated as ordinary poke you can hide from behind the wave.
audit.why: Riot's Q text says it extends its range each time it hits an enemy — a full wave makes his boomerang reach further, not shorter.

edits.before: He has to enter soldier range to kill you — that trip costs HP, and your E + R make the return trip expensive too.
edits.after: He never has to enter soldier range — Avengerang is 850 and grows through minions, so trade only when Heroic Swing is down.

edits.before: Tax the approach with soldiers, cancel the dive with R, and starve his roam game with shoves. Heroic Swing is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Tax the approach with soldiers, cancel the dive with R, and starve his roam game with shoves. Heroic Swing (18s at rank 1) is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.

edits.before: Akshan wins by landing Heroic Swing, denying your pattern, and cashing the all-in before your pattern matures.
edits.after: Akshan wins by chipping with Avengerang from 850, then swinging in when your E is down and finishing with Comeuppance.

edits.after: Ahead, siege: crash with soldier autos, take every plate, and stand behind a minion when he ults — Comeuppance stops on the first body.

edits.after: W a soldier behind the wave and farm THROUGH it — Avengerang is 850 to your 525, so every step forward is free damage for him.

edits.before: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only when his engage is down.
edits.after: Two soldiers up means a real trade: W-Q the drag-through and step back. The poke is free only while Heroic Swing is down.

edits.before: E completes the safety net — you now have the shield-dash out. Greedier soldier placements are allowed, not encouraged.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Shifting Sands spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Carry through siege control — soldiers take plates, R denies engages, and your DPS curve outlasts every assassin spike in the lobby.

edits.before: His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. Its cooldown is the green light — wait for it.

edits.before: Standing at max soldier range admiring your poke with E on cooldown — that is the engage window every Akshan player is waiting for.

notes: CHART: phases[4..6].side read 'Skill' against win[4..6] 'Akshan' and packet.levelChart 'Akshan' on all seven rows — three cross-layer disagreements removed by moving the full layer to the packet/content verdict, each with its why rewritten in the same proposal. No paired win[N] edits because win[4..6] already hold 'Akshan' on disk. UNVERIFIED: whether Emperor's Divide's soldier wall counts as terrain for the purposes of knocking Akshan off Heroic Swing. Worth confirming — if it holds, it is the best line in this matchup.
